name: qa-gate
description: When Claude tries to finish a turn after editing code, runs the project's lint, type check, spell check and test scripts from package.json, and keeps Claude working until they pass. Scripts that don't exist are skipped.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the end-of-turn quality gate on or off.

configFile.title: Project config file
configFile.description: JSON file, relative to the project, whose keys override these options (enabled, packageJson, packageManager, checks, scripts, codeExtensions, maxAttempts, timeoutSeconds or timeoutMs, scope, testArgs, watchBash).

packageJson.title: package.json path
packageJson.description: The package.json whose scripts the gate runs, relative to the project; scripts run in its folder.

packageManager.title: Package manager
packageManager.description: How to run the scripts; auto picks from the lockfile.

maxAttempts.title: Max attempts
maxAttempts.description: How many times in a row the gate sends Claude back before it lets the turn end anyway.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: all runs every script on the whole project; changed passes only the files Claude changed to the lint and spell check scripts (and to tests when testArgs is set in the project file). The type check always runs on the whole project.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout per script (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: A script still running after this long is stopped and reported as timed out.
